title: Reviewers run Sonnet from review round 2, as the rule says, though agents/reviewer.md pins haiku
why: Rule roles-third-round-steps-up (the third try steps up a model) says reviewers run Sonnet from round 2, but agents/reviewer.md pins `model: haiku` and the spawn guard refuses an override, so every fix check on Nov 11 ran haiku (lane main-protection-ruleset-text, #2622).
source: coordinator 00:05 CST Nov 12; outbox note brief-names-role-not-model
note: Stability fix after the guard test split; no owner ask (coordinator). A rule clash, not only brief wording. Related: steps builder-model-pin and reviewer-model-hook-latest. Folded from outbox note brief-names-role-not-model (coordinator 23:09 CST Nov 11): record-writer agents in lanes #2611, #2612 and q_max#1157 ran haiku although their briefs said Sonnet, since agents/record-writer.md also pins haiku; briefs name the role only, never a model.
